svg.title: Compatible rate numerators and distinct timing scopes
svg.desc: Constructed profile, unprofiled and request intervals give different rates for the same useful core work. Model-effective bandwidth differs from observed DRAM bandwidth; cross-cohort division is not directly observed evidence.

g.text: Match useful work, modeled bytes and observed traffic to time
Constructed 64³ GEMM: F=524288 FLOPs; logical Q=49152 bytes
Model intensity: 10⅔ FLOP/byte. Observed DRAM intensity: 32 FLOP/byte.
Do not divide the profile counter by the independent unprofiled duration.
FMA counts as two FLOPs by convention; do not double 2MKN again.
No real GPU time, traffic counter, bottleneck or serving gain is asserted.
